audience.persona: busy professional who feels money quietly leaks out of their account
audience.pain: forgotten subscriptions and lapsed free-trials keep charging every month
audience.desire: see and stop wasted recurring spend in minutes, without a budgeting chore

strategy.disruption_target: the belief that checking statements manually or budgeting harder is enough to catch subscription waste
strategy.hook: Budgeting apps don't catch this leak.
strategy.claim_support: The product dashboard itself shows recurring charges and a representative monthly total, so the ad can prove the category reframe visually.
strategy.promise: See every recurring charge in about a minute.
strategy.objection_addressed: Another finance app I'll download and never open?

visual.style: clean editorial product UI, single teal accent, soft shadows, light background
visual.scene: a realistic Tally mobile app dashboard listing recurring subscriptions with one monthly total highlighted
visual.subject: the Tally app dashboard shown on a phone-sized card
visual.composition: app card centered slightly high; clean negative space reserved in the bottom third for overlay text
visual.lighting: soft, even studio light with a gentle shadow beneath the card

product.representation: on-screen UI of the advertiser's own app (Tally)
must_show: subscription list with a highlighted monthly total
must_not_show: real bank names or card numbers

copy.headline: Stop paying for subscriptions you forgot
copy.primary_text: Tally finds recurring charges quietly draining your account, then helps you cancel what you don't use.

layout.typography: bold condensed sans, high-contrast dark text, generous size
layout.safe_zones: keep key UI and text within the central 90%; clear the bottom ~15% for platform primary text and CTA

prompting.final_image_prompt: A realistic, clean mobile finance app dashboard for an app called 'Tally', shown as a single phone-sized card floating on a plain off-white studio background. The screen lists a few recurring subscriptions with short generic placeholder names and small prices, and one large highlighted monthly total reading '$312/mo' in a teal accent. A small 'Tally' wordmark sits at the top of the app screen. Soft, even studio lighting with a gentle shadow under the card. Minimal and editorial, single teal accent color, with clean empty space in the lower third of the frame.

qa.readability_check: Overlay reads in one glance; dark text on light UI passes the thumbnail squint test.
qa.native_platform_check: Reads like a real product screenshot, native to Meta feed; not stocky or corporate.
policy_risks: Dollar figures shown in the UI are illustrative sample data, not a specific user's result — keep them clearly representative, never presented as a testimonial.
qa.iteration_notes: Test a 1:1 variant and a version with the total in the upper third; A/B the headline against a question hook.

audience.persona: person who suspects small recurring charges are adding up but hasn't looked
audience.pain: free trials that auto-converted and old subscriptions keep charging unnoticed
audience.desire: stop paying for things they no longer use

strategy.disruption_target: the default behavior of ignoring old free trials and assuming small recurring charges are harmless
strategy.hook: Don't let a 2021 free trial bill you again.
strategy.claim_support: The receipt-spilling visual makes the hidden recurring-charge problem instantly legible even before the viewer reads the body copy.
strategy.promise: Tally surfaces what you forgot so you can cancel it.
strategy.objection_addressed: I don't have time to audit my bank statements.

visual.style: clean conceptual still life, single bold accent, editorial
visual.scene: a long printed receipt spilling and tangling out of a smartphone, symbolizing money quietly leaking
visual.subject: one smartphone with a long printed receipt tangling outward and down
visual.composition: phone in the upper-middle, receipt spilling down through the frame; clean negative space reserved at the top for overlay text
visual.lighting: soft top light with a soft shadow

product.representation: implied (named in copy; UI not shown)

copy.overlay_text: Don't let a 2021 free trial bill you again
copy.headline: Cancel subscriptions you forgot about
copy.primary_text: Old free trials and forgotten subscriptions keep charging your card. Tally spots them so you can cancel in a tap.

layout.typography: bold sans, high contrast, generous size
layout.safe_zones: clear the top ~10% and bottom ~15% for platform chrome

qa.readability_check: Single bold question reads instantly at the top; strong figure-ground contrast.
qa.native_platform_check: Conceptual but candid; reads native to feed, not stocky.
qa.iteration_notes: Test a receipt-pile vs. a single glowing recurring charge; cut a 9:16 story variant.
